review_rules: Fresh independent context after all public source/claim barriers. Anonymous source capsules; no arm names, skill identities or prior judgments. Read exact independent public/hidden expectations, native raw evidence and original images. Source-only style declarations must be labelled source_only, not runtime computed properties. Missing coverage remains U. Strict numeric F is not automatically a product defect. Require original source/line/expectation/image references for each F and cause. Two reviewers independently assess all candidates before reveal; disagreements remain U, no forced consensus.

requirements.id: independently indexed requirement or source-audit id

analysis: Root mechanically compares both original reports; only agreed P completes a requirement, agreed source-grounded product F establishes a product defect; disagreement or ambiguous attribution remains U. Cross-version defect matching uses approved obligation and independently described cause, with any uncertainty disclosed. Keep both original panels and all original alarms.
